checks.command: pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run test && cd services/dsh/backend && go test ./...
checks.proves: Field offline regression tests and DSH idempotency/auth behavior pass together.
checks.passCriteria: Canonical field tests and backend tests pass with direct legacy/ambiguous/retry coverage.
checks.failCriteria: No direct offline tests, silent-drop expectation, duplicate mutation or any failure fails.

checks.command: DEVICE: enqueue each governed field operation offline, restart app, verify actor/install isolation, restore network, exercise transient or ambiguous response and confirm canonical DSH readback before/after retry.
checks.passCriteria: Queued work survives authorized restart, never crosses actor scope, reconciles safely and surfaces terminal failure without false success.
checks.failCriteria: Lost work, cross-actor replay, duplicate mutation or false success fails.
